stepNotes.1: Confirmed the 12-file inventory and the CodeIntelligence -> CodeGraphQuery -> schema.sql.ts layering; no Drizzle imports leak past query.ts except the schema declarations themselves.
stepNotes.2: IndexLock uses atomic fs.open(wx) plus a process.kill pid liveness probe that correctly treats EPERM as alive; native flock() path auto-releases on crash. Fire-and-forget auto-index converts every error into a visible state transition.
stepNotes.3: Per-file write transaction at builder-impl.ts:1054 is atomic (delete+insert+upsert); sha short-circuit only trusts completeness==='full' and never recycles node ids. Gap found: query.ts:319 deleteFile is the only CRUD op missing the useNative dispatch and NativeStore has no deleteFile.
stepNotes.4: Hotspot: builder-impl.ts:1025 listFiles is called per committed file making import resolution O(files^2); parseImportSpecifiers is O(text*matches) with no size guard. countNodes/countEdges and deleteEdgesTouchingFile are already optimized.
stepNotes.5: Scope policy lives at the facade (inScope, index.ts:76) and is independently re-checked with realpath in graph-context.ts:190 against symlink escape; graphEnvelope is provenance-only by design and never a fallback router.
stepNotes.6: No empty catches or TODOs; all constants named. Minor: inFlight/triedProjects Sets in auto-index.ts:166/174 are uncapped process-lifetime (acknowledged debt); watcher instances Map is cleaned via Instance.onLifecycle.
